if.test: userRole != null and userRole != '' and userRole != 'ALL'
status != null and status != '' and status != 'ALL'

mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_NO, U.USER_ID, U.NAME, U.USER_ROLE, U.STATUS, U.CREATED_AT, F.APPROVAL_STATUS FROM USERS U JOIN FIXER_PROFILE F ON U.USER_NO = F.USER_NO WHERE F.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY U.CREATED_AT ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS U LEFT JOIN FIXER_PROFILE F ON U.USER_NO = F.USER_NO

SELECT U.USER_NO, U.USER_ID, U.NAME, U.USER_ROLE, U.STATUS, U.CREATED_AT, F.APPROVAL_STATUS, ROUND(AVG(R.SCORE), 1) AS AVG_SCORE, COUNT(R.REVIEW_ID) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM USERS U LEFT JOIN FIXER_PROFILE F ON U.USER_NO = F.USER_NO LEFT JOIN REVIEW R ON U.USER_NO = R.FIXER_NO
GROUP BY U.USER_NO, U.USER_ID, U.NAME, U.USER_ROLE, U.STATUS, U.CREATED_AT, F.APPROVAL_STATUS ORDER BY U.CREATED_AT DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT U.USER_NO, U.USER_ID, U.NAME, U.PHONE, U.EMAIL, U.USER_ROLE, U.STATUS, U.CREATED_AT, F.INTRO, F.CAREER_YEARS, F.APPROVAL_STATUS, F.APPROVED_AT, F.REJECT_REASON FROM USERS U LEFT JOIN FIXER_PROFILE F ON U.USER_NO = F.USER_NO WHERE U.USER_NO = #{userNo}
SELECT LICENSE_ID, USER_NO, LICENSE_NAME, UPLOAD_URL, ISSUED_AT FROM FIXER_LICENSE WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY ISSUED_AT DESC
SELECT C.CODE_NAME FROM FIXER_CATEGORY FC JOIN COMMON_CODE C ON FC.CATEGORY_CODE = C.CODE_ID WHERE FC.USER_NO = #{userNo}
SELECT C.CODE_NAME FROM FIXER_REGION FR JOIN COMMON_CODE C ON FR.REGION_CODE = C.CODE_ID WHERE FR.USER_NO = #{userNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE FIXER_PROFILE SET APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED', APPROVED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, REJECT_REASON = NULL WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
